name: addpipe16_carry_skip_var
rationale: All uniform-group carry-skip/CLA/prefix attempts trade cell count for critical-path depth, but analysis of the carry-skip topology shows only the FIRST group's generate delay (feeds into the skip chain) and the LAST group's internal ripple depth (after receiving the final skip carry) lie on the true critical path; middle groups' internal generate/propagate logic is computed in parallel with the inter-group skip chain and is largely off the critical path. The previously-tried uniform 4x4 carry-skip (299.516 area, 7.37783 WNS) wastes delay with a 4-bit ripple tail. This candidate keeps the same 3-hop skip-chain structure (so area/hop overhead stays similar) but rebalances group sizes to [5,5,4,2] bits from LSB to MSB, shrinking the tail group to 2 bits to minimize the final ripple depth while absorbing the extra bits into non-critical middle groups. This should shorten the worst-case combinational path relative to the uniform carry-skip4 point (better WNS) at a similar or only modestly larger area, plausibly producing a new non-dominated area/WNS frontier point between carry_skip4 and the deeper prefix-tree designs.
